topics.title: About this volume
topics.summary: Book VIII takes distributed C++ services into production infrastructure. The emphasis is on connecting application contracts to deployment, identity, networking, observability, scaling, security, reliability, and recovery. HarborDispatch remains the recurring instructional service.

topics.title: How to use this book
topics.summary: For every mechanism ask: what requirement does it serve, what state does it control, what evidence proves the outcome, and how is the change reversed or recovered? Use isolated labs before adapting examples to real infrastructure. Provider APIs and managed-service behavior change; verify current vendor documentation before deployment.
